project_type: Full-stack monorepo: React SPA (frontend), Python FastAPI (backend), TypeScript Cloudflare Workers (edge)
build_system: pnpm workspace (packageManager: pnpm@10.26.1), pip for backend
test_framework: pytest with conftest.py (backend), vitest (frontend/edge via pnpm test)
build_command: pnpm --filter syrabit-edge exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter @workspace/syrabit exec tsc --noEmit
test_command: cd apps/backend && python -m pytest tests/ --tb=short -q; cd ../../ && pnpm --filter syrabit-edge test; pnpm --filter @workspace/syrabit test
verification_instructions: 1. Run ruff check on backend. 2. Run tsc --noEmit on edge and frontend. 3. Run pytest on backend. 4. Run pnpm test on edge and frontend.
setup_instructions: 1. corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@10.26.1 --activate. 2. pnpm install. 3. pip install -r apps/backend/requirements.txt (with hash stripping).
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access available. No Docker daemon needed for validation - use lint/typecheck/unit tests. Redis (Upstash HTTP) not available in test env.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing code patterns. Use ruff for Python linting. TypeScript strict mode for edge workers.
key_patterns: Backend: singleton services (search_indexer, content_pipeline, etc.), beanie ODM for MongoDB, httpx async HTTP client, pydantic settings. Frontend: React lazy loading, AuthGuard/AdminGuard/StaffGuard route protection, sonner toasts, lucide-react icons. Edge: Cloudflare Workers with KV bindings, HMAC request signing.
directory_structure: Root: pnpm monorepo. apps/backend: Python FastAPI with app/api/v1/ (routes), app/services/ (business logic), app/models/ (beanie models), app/config.py, tests/. apps/frontend: React SPA with src/components/, src/pages/, public/ (sw.js, offline.html, manifest.json). apps/edge: Cloudflare Workers with src/routes/, src/middleware/. .github/workflows: CI/CD pipelines.
